description.value: The Den is a retro arcade bar and lounge tucked into the ground floor of the Barclay Hotel on Vancouver's Robson Street, featuring classic games like Pac-Man, pinball, Golden Tee, and Buck Hunter alongside a jukebox and nostalgic murals of the Beastie Boys, Run DMC, and Bill Murray. The bar has no kitchen but openly welcomes guests to bring their own food or order in from nearby restaurants. It bills itself as a deliberately casual, basement-den atmosphere — cheap drinks, killer tunes, and a chill vibe.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (5 spaces) at 51m; stands (2 spaces) at 56m; stands (2 spaces) at 67m. Total: 9 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms The Den is an active arcade bar/drinkery at 1348 Robson Street inside the Barclay Hotel, matching the OSM address and URL. The website explicitly states 'we don't have a kitchen,' ruling out food preparation, packed lunches, and in-house food takeout; no bike-specific amenities are mentioned on the site or in OSM tags. OSM wheelchair=no and outdoor_seating=no are consistent with the website's description of a compact indoor lounge.
